BUSINESS_AREA.DESCRIPTION: Fixed Asset Management: ask about assets, their category/depreciation basis, branch/location/department/custody, warranty & AMC coverage, physical verification findings, and lifecycle events (installation, transfer, disposal).

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: One row per asset (Fixed Asset or Other Asset) — the master record: identity, category, org placement (branch/location/department), custodian employee, purchase cost, capitalization, Companies Act and Income Tax depreciation fields, warranty dates, AMC flag and lifecycle status. This is the anchor table for almost every question in this area.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: System-generated unique code identifying the asset.
Name of the asset.
Date the asset was capitalized (put into use / brought onto the books). Depreciation for the asset starts from this date.
Optional parent asset this record is a component of (self-referencing to another Asset Register row).
FIXED_ASSET (depreciable) or OTHER_ASSET (non-depreciable). Locked permanently after the record is first saved.
Asset category — links to FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER, which supplies default useful life / method / residual value.
Lifecycle status: DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, CAPITALIZED (in active use), UNDER_TRANSFER, DISPOSED, UNDER_INVESTIGATION (e.g. flagged missing/damaged during a physical verification).
Date the asset was disposed (sale/scrap); set automatically when its Asset Disposal record is approved.
Date the asset was last physically verified; set automatically when a physical verification cycle covering it is approved.
Manufacturer serial number.
Manufacturer/brand of the asset.
Model number/name of the asset.
Free text description of the asset.
Branch where the asset is located — links to FAM_BRANCH_MASTER.
Physical location (building/floor/room/site) within the branch — links to FAM_LOCATION_MASTER (keyed by BRANCH_CODE + LOCATION_CODE).
Department/cost centre the asset belongs to — links to FAM_DEPARTMENT_MASTER (keyed by BRANCH_CODE + DEPARTMENT_CODE).
Employee currently in custody of the asset — links to FAM_EMPLOYEE_MASTER.
Free text vendor/supplier name the asset was purchased from (not a master lookup).
Vendor invoice number for the purchase.
Date the asset was purchased.
Base purchase cost of the asset.
Freight, installation, duties and other costs capitalized with the asset.
Purchase Cost + Other Capitalized Cost — the asset's gross book value.
Useful life in years under the Companies Act, defaulted from the category. Applies only to Fixed Assets.
Depreciation method under the Companies Act: SLM (Straight Line) or WDV (Written Down Value). Applies only to Fixed Assets.
Residual value percentage used to compute Companies Act Residual Value.
Total Capitalized Cost x Residual Value % — the floor value the asset never depreciates below under the Companies Act.
Written-down value under the Companies Act as on Opening WDV As On Date, for a legacy asset onboarded with prior depreciation history.

System-computed total Companies Act accumulated depreciation from capitalization to date (or disposal), capped at the Companies Act residual value. Net book value under the Companies Act = Total Capitalized Cost - this value.

Income Tax block-of-assets code — links to FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER. This is a SEPARATE depreciation basis from the Companies Act fields above; the two regimes are computed independently and must not be confused.
Written-down value under the Income Tax block as on Income Tax Opening WDV As On Date, for a legacy asset onboarded with prior depreciation history.
Start date of the manufacturer/vendor warranty recorded directly on the asset. Detailed multi-record warranty history lives in FAM_WARRANTY_DETAILS.
End date of the manufacturer/vendor warranty. A warranty is EXPIRED when this date is before the current date.
Y/N flag — whether an Annual Maintenance Contract currently covers this asset. For contract detail/dates, join to FAM_AMC_CONTRACT_LINE / FAM_AMC_CONTRACTS.
Free text remarks about the asset.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Asset category master — one row per category, carrying the default Companies Act useful life, method, residual %, and default Income Tax block for assets placed in that category.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Unique code identifying the category.
Descriptive name of the category (e.g. Furniture, Computers, Vehicles).
A = Active (usable on new assets), I = Inactive (blocked for new use).
FIXED_ASSET or OTHER_ASSET — which register this category is offered on.
Optional parent category for hierarchical classification (self-referencing).
Default useful life in years under Companies Act Schedule II for this category.
Default depreciation method for the category: SLM or WDV.
Default residual value percentage for the category.
Default Income Tax block-of-assets code applied to assets in this category.
Unique code identifying the branch.
Name of the branch.
City in which the branch is located.
State in which the branch is located.
A = Active, I = Inactive.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Physical location master (building/floor/room/site) within a branch. Keyed by BRANCH_CODE + LOCATION_CODE.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Branch this location belongs to.
Unique location code within the branch.
Name of the location.
A = Active, I = Inactive.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Department/cost centre master within a branch. Keyed by BRANCH_CODE + DEPARTMENT_CODE.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Branch this department belongs to.
Unique department code within the branch.
Name of the department/cost centre.
Cost centre code associated with this department.
A = Active, I = Inactive.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Employee master — used as the asset custodian, verifier, and installer reference.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Unique code identifying the employee.
Full name of the employee.
Job designation/title of the employee.
A = Active, I = Inactive, T = Transferred.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: One rate record per category: the official Companies Act Schedule II useful life, method (SLM/WDV) and residual value % norm, effective from a given date.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Category this rate norm applies to.
Useful life in years as per Schedule II.
SLM or WDV.
Residual value as % of original cost.
Date from which this rate norm is effective.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: One rate record per Income Tax block-of-assets: the WDV depreciation rate %, effective from a given date.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Income Tax block-of-assets code.
Description of the block of assets.
Depreciation rate as % of the block's Written Down Value.
Date from which this block rate is effective.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Header of a physical verification cycle — a planned/conducted stock-check run scoped to a branch, location and optional category, run by a verifier employee.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Auto-generated verification cycle number.
Date the verification cycle is planned/conducted.
Branch where the verification is conducted.
Location within the branch being verified.
Optional asset category filter used when loading assets into this cycle.
Employee responsible for conducting this verification cycle.
Cycle status: PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_APPROVAL, CLOSED, CANCELLED.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Per-asset finding within a physical verification cycle — whether the asset was found, its condition, and expected vs actual location/custodian (a discrepancy is any line where the found location/employee differs from expected, or PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND is NOT_FOUND / DAMAGED / EXTRA_UNREGISTERED).

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Parent verification cycle.
Line sequence number within the cycle.
Asset being verified on this line.
Outcome of the physical check: FOUND, NOT_FOUND, DAMAGED, EXTRA_UNREGISTERED. Anything other than FOUND is a discrepancy worth flagging.
Date this asset was physically verified.
Notes on the finding (damage description, reason not found, etc.).
Location the asset was expected to be found at.
Employee the asset was expected to be assigned to.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Detailed warranty coverage history for an asset (an asset can have multiple warranty records over time, e.g. original + extended warranty), each with its own vendor, start/end date and terms.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Asset covered by this warranty.
Vendor providing the warranty (free text — no Vendor Master exists yet in this project).
Date the warranty coverage begins.
Date the warranty coverage ends. Expired when this date is before the current date.
Coverage terms and conditions of the warranty.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Annual Maintenance Contract header — vendor, coverage period, cost and lifecycle status; may renew a previous contract.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Auto-generated AMC contract number.
Vendor providing the AMC coverage (free text — no Vendor Master exists yet).
Date the AMC coverage begins.
Date the AMC coverage ends. Expired when this date is before the current date.
Total cost of the AMC contract.
Contract lifecycle status: DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, ACTIVE, EXPIRED, RENEWED, CANCELLED.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Per-asset coverage line under an AMC contract — which assets are covered by a given contract.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Parent AMC contract.
Line sequence number within the contract.
Asset covered under this AMC contract.
Notes on the scope/terms of coverage for this asset.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Installation/commissioning record for a capitalized asset — who installed it, when, and whether the physical location was confirmed.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Asset being installed/commissioned.
Date the asset was physically installed/commissioned.
Employee who carried out the installation.
Y/N — whether the physical installation location matches the asset's assigned location.
PENDING, CONFIRMED, or CANCELLED.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Asset transfer record — moving an asset's branch/location/department/custodian from one org placement to another.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Auto-generated transfer number.
Date the transfer is recorded.
Asset being transferred.
DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, CANCELLED.
Asset's branch before the transfer.
Asset's location before the transfer.
Asset's custodian before the transfer.
Branch the asset is being moved to.
Location the asset is being moved to.
Employee the asset custody is being moved to.
Reason/justification for the transfer.

TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Asset disposal record — sale or scrap of an asset, with net book value at disposal and resulting profit/loss.

COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: Auto-generated disposal number.
Date the disposal is recorded.
Asset being disposed.
DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, CANCELLED.
SALE or SCRAP.
Sale proceeds (mandatory for Sale, zero for Scrap).
Computed net book value of the asset as on the disposal date.
Sale Value minus Net Book Value at Disposal.
Reason/justification for the disposal.

JOINS.DESCRIPTION: Each asset belongs to a category, which supplies default depreciation norms.
Each asset is located at a branch.
Each asset sits at a physical location within its branch (Location is keyed by branch + location code).
Each asset belongs to a department/cost centre within its branch (Department is keyed by branch + department code).
Each asset may be assigned to a custodian employee.
A category's official Companies Act rate norm.
An asset's Income Tax block-of-assets rate.
Detailed warranty history records for an asset (an asset can have several).
AMC coverage lines for an asset.
Each AMC coverage line belongs to an AMC contract header (vendor, period, cost, status).
Physical verification findings for an asset across all verification cycles it has been checked in.
Each verification line belongs to a verification cycle header (branch, location, date, verifier, status).
Transfer history for an asset (movements between branch/location/department/custodian).
Disposal record for an asset, if it has been sold or scrapped.

BUSINESS_AREA.JOINS_DESCRIPTION: FAM_ASSET_REGISTER is the anchor: it joins to FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER on CATEGORY_CODE, to FAM_BRANCH_MASTER on BRANCH_CODE, to FAM_LOCATION_MASTER on BRANCH_CODE+LOCATION_CODE (location is keyed within its branch), to FAM_DEPARTMENT_MASTER on BRANCH_CODE+DEPARTMENT_CODE (department is keyed within its branch), and to FAM_EMPLOYEE_MASTER on ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_CODE for the current custodian. Depreciation rate norms hang off the category (FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER -> FAM_DEP_RATE_CA_MASTER by CATEGORY_CODE) and off the asset's Income Tax block (FAM_ASSET_REGISTER -> FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER by INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE) — these are two SEPARATE depreciation bases, never mix Companies Act and Income Tax figures in the same computation. Warranty, AMC and lifecycle-event tables (FAM_WARRANTY_DETAILS, FAM_AMC_CONTRACT_LINE -> FAM_AMC_CONTRACTS, FAM_ASSET_INSTALLATION, FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER, FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL) all hang off FAM_ASSET_REGISTER by ASSET_CODE (one-to-many). Physical verification is two-level: FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE carries the per-asset finding and joins to FAM_ASSET_REGISTER by ASSET_CODE, and each line belongs to a FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION cycle header (join by VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO) which carries the cycle's branch/location/date/verifier/status.
BUSINESS_AREA.AI_INSTRUCTIONS: STATUS on FAM_ASSET_REGISTER: DRAFT and PENDING_APPROVAL are not-yet-live records; CAPITALIZED means the asset is in active use and depreciating; UNDER_TRANSFER means a transfer is in progress; DISPOSED means it has been sold/scrapped (see FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL for detail); UNDER_INVESTIGATION typically follows a physical verification finding of NOT_FOUND or DAMAGED. Unless the user asks otherwise, 'active assets' or 'current assets' means STATUS = 'CAPITALIZED'. 'Capitalized' means the asset's cost has been recognized on the books as of CAPITALIZATION_DATE — depreciation starts from that date. Companies Act depreciation fields (COMPANIES_ACT_*, TOTAL_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION, OPENING_WDV) and Income Tax fields (INCOME_TAX_*) are two INDEPENDENT depreciation bases computed with different methods/rates — never sum or compare them directly, and always state which basis a depreciation/net-book-value answer uses. Net book value under the Companies Act = TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST - TOTAL_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION (never below COMPANIES_ACT_RESIDUAL_VALUE). AMC_APPLICABLE = 'Y' means an Annual Maintenance Contract currently covers the asset; to check the contract's actual dates/status join to FAM_AMC_CONTRACT_LINE -> FAM_AMC_CONTRACTS. Warranty/AMC 'expiring' or 'expired' means comparing END_DATE (or WARRANTY_END_DATE) against the current date (:current_date) — 'expiring this month' means END_DATE falls within the current calendar month and is not already in the past. A physical verification 'discrepancy' means a FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE row where PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND is not 'FOUND' (i.e. NOT_FOUND, DAMAGED or EXTRA_UNREGISTERED), or where the found location/employee differs from EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE/EXPECTED_EMPLOYEE_CODE. When a question mentions 'category X' by name, match on CATEGORY_NAME (case-insensitive), not CATEGORY_CODE, unless a code is explicitly given; the same applies to branch/location/department names vs codes. Amounts (PURCHASE_COST, TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST, depreciation, contract cost, sale/disposal values) are plain numeric currency figures with no currency conversion needed. VENDOR_NAME, WARRANTY_PROVIDER_VENDOR_CODE, AMC_VENDOR_CODE and BUYER_OR_SCRAP_VENDOR_CODE are free text (no Vendor Master exists yet in this project), so match them with case-insensitive partial matching, not exact lookup joins.
